candidates.name: Existing Electron builder and UAR-enabled Mac package path
candidates.fit_for_gap: Usable local Mac app at each complete delivery boundary

evidence.claim: build:mac:arm64 forces UAR=0; enabled alternate exists; electron-builder pin26.15.6.
extraResources installs native files outside app.asar; executable sidecars should use physical resource paths.

risks: Build command change is proposed only.
DMG integrity is not app/UAR operational acceptance.
candidates.decision_rationale: Make the exact required command produce enabled local UAR payloads, reuse native packaging and one completed-phase gate.

candidates.name: Existing UAR sidecar packaging plus local Mac payload record
candidates.fit_for_gap: Remove Windows payload dependency from local Mac delivery

evidence.claim: Existing script emits tar and file checksums with HEAD provenance.
Canonical importer requires Windows x64 and Mac ARM64 payloads from same revision.

risks: Local overlay does not exist yet.
Dirty sources cannot be labeled solely with HEAD.
Local payload must never leak into public CI manifest.
candidates.decision_rationale: Freeze committed source and validate source/architecture/archive and file hashes in an explicit local-only input; preserve immutable public manifest contracts.

candidates.name: Frozen multi-platform release jobs and serialized publication
candidates.fit_for_gap: Per-delivery operator-controlled macOS and Windows rollout

evidence.claim: Non-UAR profile supports four architectures; UAR-enabled currently only win32-x64 and darwin-arm64.
Source/version/profile consistency is enforced for reuse.

risks: Mac Intel and Windows ARM64 UAR payloads and packaging remain required work.
No latest-source mutation after boundary freeze.
candidates.decision_rationale: Reuse release machinery; add missing UAR targets through approved implementation, publish only on a recorded boundary choice, no Linux.

candidates.name: Existing agent team lifecycle and bounded optimization observer
candidates.fit_for_gap: Parallel ownership without Cargo contention or testing loops

evidence.claim: Existing team-update/task ownership and expected revision operations exist; native harness executes work.

risks: Role exports still contain conflicting test-first policy.
candidates.decision_rationale: Separate runtime, Boss UI, packaging and documentation ownership; one heavy local build writer; observer can advise from logs, never authorize tests or replan.

candidates.name: KBD/OpenSpec with existing Karpathy progress recorder
candidates.fit_for_gap: Traceability and delivery learning without a second scheduler

evidence.claim: Existing recorder provides durable local log/receipt with bounded remote pk delivery.
Previous local receipt succeeded but shared pk ingest timed out; historical agent durations unknown.

risks: Existing closed event schema is not a full telemetry store.
candidates.decision_rationale: Link a small per-delivery metric artifact through existing events; preserve canonical task ownership and C-package meanings.

candidates.name: Worktree-local incremental Compass refresh
candidates.fit_for_gap: Hourly code navigation with bounded resource use

evidence.claim: Cold UAR update134.98s; ~0.88GB graph, incomplete coverage; real controller query succeeded.

risks: 43 identity collisions prevent confident negative coverage.
candidates.decision_rationale: Refresh changed active worktrees hourly, serialize with heavy packaging, record actual delay and affected-symbol query; no repeat full scans of clean roots.

candidates.name: All platforms on each hourly local critical path
candidates.fit_for_gap: Immediate usable local app with optional broader release

evidence.claim: Two requested UAR architectures not yet enabled.
Existing public import couples two native payloads.

risks: Native CI delays and absent target support can stall local delivery.
candidates.decision_rationale: Keep immutable public release inputs but remove them as prerequisites to a fresh local Mac artifact.

candidates.name: Runtime-only sidecar path override as local delivery

evidence.claim: Runtime owner inspected uarPayload.ts:63–70: THE_BOSS_UAR_SIDECAR_PATH redirects launch but does not embed payload. Reject this as packaged acceptance.

risks: Developer machine can hide stale or missing packaged binary.
candidates.decision_rationale: Require the built app to launch its packaged helper, with runtime path override cleared.

build_required.need: Exact local arm64 command with current packaged UAR and source-bound payload staging
build_required.why_no_candidate: Existing scripts disable UAR or require both platform records; adapting existing repo code is smaller than new tooling.

build_required.need: UAR-enabled Mac Intel and Windows ARM64 release payloads
build_required.why_no_candidate: Current UAR profile lists only customer-critical pair; platform prerequisites must be implemented and honestly accounted for.

build_required.need: Core and Boss UI delivery slices mapped to existing C packages
build_required.why_no_candidate: Existing sequential roadmap delays UI; needs operator-approved dependency revision, not a replacement framework.
